hero.tagline: Know the risk. Know the next action.
hero.description: Farm-specific ocean risk, harvest timing and one clear next step for Zanzibar's seaweed farmers, on a smartphone, by SMS or on any basic phone.

preview.reason: Sea temperature above normal for 8 days
preview.action: Inspect lines within 24 hours and record whitening or breakage.

loop.title: Monitor → Predict → Act → Learn
loop.subtitle: Every prediction leads to an approved action, and every action is followed by an outcome that improves the next prediction.
loop.monitorText: Sea temperature, waves, wind and rain for each farm, combined with what farmers see on their lines.
loop.predictText: A transparent risk engine estimates heat / ice-ice, storm, poor-growth and harvest-window risk for the next 72 hours, with reasons.
loop.actText: The action engine picks one clear next step from an expert-reviewed action library — never free-form AI advice.
loop.learnText: Farmers record what they did and what happened. Real outcomes measure how good the predictions were and train better models.

flow.title: The full data loop
flow.loopNote: Learning data flows back into the next risk calculation.

honesty.title: Advice you can check
honesty.subtitle: Decision support, not guesswork. Every number shows where it came from and why it matters for your farm.

model.title: Transparent model
model.text: Risk comes from a transparent rule-based baseline, optionally blended with an ML model. Each prediction shows its reasons and the model used.

library.title: Validated action library
library.text: Recommendations only come from an action library reviewed by local experts. Rules that are not yet validated are marked clearly.

claims.title: No unproven claims
claims.text: We make no accuracy or loss-reduction claims until they are measured in a field evaluation with real outcomes.

sources.title: Traceable data
sources.text: Every reading shows its source: live weather and ocean data from Open-Meteo, or the last saved live reading. If there is none, the app says so and relies on your own reports.

cta.title: Protect your next harvest
cta.text: Create an account, add your farm and get a risk outlook with a clear next action.

about.title: Farm-specific decisions for Zanzibar's seaweed farmers
about.subtitle: Seaweed farming is an important source of income for many coastal families in Zanzibar, and much of the work is done by women. A changing ocean makes every season harder to predict.
about.problem1: Farmers can find general weather and ocean information, but it rarely tells them what it means for their own lines, this week, and what to do about it.
about.problem2: Losses often come from events that give warning signs days in advance. Without timely, farm-specific and actionable advice, those signs are missed.

heat.title: Heat stress and ice-ice
heat.text: Warm sea temperatures over several days stress the seaweed and trigger ice-ice disease, which can wipe out a crop.

storm.title: Storms and line damage
storm.text: Strong winds and waves break lines and pull out stakes, especially on exposed farms.

growth.title: Poor growth
growth.text: Low nutrients, heavy rain and epiphytes slow growth and reduce the harvest.

harvest.title: Harvest timing
harvest.text: Harvesting too early or too late lowers yield and quality; drying in the rain reduces price.

about.answer: MwaniMlinzi AI turns environmental data and farmers' own observations into a risk level for each farm, a short explanation of why, and one approved next action. It then records what the farmer did and what happened, so advice can be checked against reality and improved.

serves.farmers: Get risk and advice for their own farm on web, SMS or USSD, and keep a record of their farm history.
serves.admins: Keep an eye on every farm, act on alerts, and make sure the advice farmers receive stays correct.

about.privacyIntro: Farm data belongs to farmers. We only collect what is needed to give useful advice.

consent.title: Consent first
consent.text: Every account is created with explicit consent explaining how farm records are used.

rbac.title: Role-based access
rbac.text: Farmers see only their own farms, and admins manage the system and field operations. Every change is audit-logged.

ownership.title: Farmers own their data
ownership.text: Records are used to give the farmer advice and to improve the risk models — not sold.

about.honestyNote: Weather and ocean conditions come live from Open-Meteo. If they cannot be fetched, the app uses the last saved live reading; if there is none, it says so clearly and relies on the farmer's own reports.

how.title: How MwaniMlinzi works
how.subtitle: A transparent pipeline from ocean data to an approved action — and back again through real outcomes.

environment.title: Environmental data
environment.text: Sea surface temperature and its anomaly, waves, wind, rain and currents for each farm, fetched live from Open-Meteo — or the last saved live reading. If there is none, the app says so and relies on the farmer's reports.

risk.title: Risk engine
risk.text: A rule-based baseline scores each risk using known drivers (e.g. days of elevated temperature, crop age, exposure). An ML model can be blended in when one is trained and activated.

action.title: Action engine
action.text: For the highest risk, the engine selects a matching entry from the approved Action Library — by risk type, level, crop stage and conditions.

approved.title: Approved recommendation
approved.text: The farmer receives one clear next action, the reasons behind it, its urgency and whether an administrator should be contacted.

llm.title: Language model (explanation only)
llm.text: If configured, a language model may rephrase or translate the approved answer. It never invents risks, numbers or actions.

farmer.title: Farmer action
farmer.text: The farmer records whether the action was taken, and reports symptoms from the farm.

outcome.title: Outcome
outcome.text: Harvests and losses are recorded, showing whether the predicted risk actually happened.

learning.title: Learning
learning.text: Outcomes and feedback measure precision and recall in the field and become training data for future models.

how.guardrail: Guardrail: every recommendation shown to a farmer comes from the Action Library. Entries not yet validated by local experts are marked "pending validation".

web.title: Web app
web.text: Mobile-first app for farmers plus dashboards for admins.

sms.title: SMS
sms.text: Commands such as RISK FARM001 or RIPOTI FARM001 WEUPE 20%, plus automatic alert messages.

ussd.title: USSD
ussd.text: Dial the MwaniMlinzi USSD code on any phone: check risk, report symptoms, record harvests, get advice and change language.

roles.FARMER: View own farm risk and next action, record observations, actions and harvests, use SMS/USSD and the assistant.
roles.ADMIN: Monitor all farms and alerts, review farmer reports, validate the action library, generate harvest forecasts, and manage users, settings, models and the audit log.
